svg.aria-label: Bug journal. App ran out of memory after repeated trips through media-heavy forms. Cause: Strong reference cycles in table view cells kept every visited screen alive, and image loading held on to more than it needed. Fix: Broke the cycles and corrected how images were loaded and released. Real-time camera scanning lost stability as the ML pipeline ran. Cause: Object lifecycles in the frame pipeline were too long, and each frame did intermediate work it didn't need. Fix: Tightened lifecycles and removed the unnecessary computations. Recorded media arrived corrupted, worst on flaky networks. Cause: Recording configuration and encoding didn't match, and uploads weren't handled safely under poor connectivity. Fix: Corrected the recording setup, encoding and upload handling. Editing one nested form quietly overwrote data in another. Cause: State updates weren't scoped, so a change in one subform leaked into other instances. Fix: Isolated updates to the active subform.
